hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "\.rs\"" && cargo clippy --quiet 2>&1 | head -20 || true'
bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "db\.rs\"" && cargo test --bin bottymcbotface-rs data::db:: -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tail -10 || true'
bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "dnd\.rs\"" && cargo test --bin bottymcbotface-rs dnd:: 2>&1 | tail -15 || true'
bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "dnd_cmds\.rs\"" && cargo test --bin bottymcbotface-rs commands::dnd_cmds:: 2>&1 | tail -10 || true'
bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "\.env\"" && echo "Blocked: .env contains live secrets (DISCORD_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN). Edit manually." >&2 && exit 1 || true'

bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "make-release-to-pi" && echo "WARNING: Editing make-release-to-pi — this script touches the live Pi DB and restarts the bot. Confirm changes are intentional." >&2 || true'
